HousingWorks Infrastructure Program (HWIP)

Competitive grant program available to all Massachusetts municipalities for a variety of horizontal infrastructure related activities to support and unlock housing.

The Details

What you need

The HousingWorks Infrastructure Program (HWIP) is a competitive grant open to municipalities for a variety of infrastructure projects associated with housing development. This grant program awards funds based on the project’s nexus with housing, transportation, infrastructure, and community development needs.

Program Guidelines

Review the FY27 HousingWorks Infrastructure Program Guidelines prior to submitting a full application. Full applications must be submitted through the Community One Stop for Growth.

How to apply

The HousingWorks Infrastructure Program is part of the Community One Stop for Growth, a single application portal and collaborative review process of community and economic development grant programs that make targeted investments based on a Development Continuum. It is designed to allow applicants to apply for consideration of multiple sources of funding to support multiple phases and facets of a project. For more information, including key dates, frequently asked questions, and instructions on submitting an Expression of Interest and Full Application, visit www.mass.gov/onestop.

Next steps

For Award Recipients

HWIP award recipients may contact their assigned EOHLC program representative for information and questions about grant administration, reporting, and disbursement of awarded funds.
